description: This file defines the SettingsActivity class, which is an Android activity responsible for displaying the settings screen. It sets the content view and manages fragment transactions to load the SettingsFragment into the activity.

classes.name: SettingsActivity
classes.description: An Android activity class that manages the settings screen, inflating the layout and loading the SettingsFragment upon creation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity is created, responsible for initializing the activity, setting up layout, and fragment transaction.
